features.title: Harden the autonomous development loop foundation
acceptance_criteria: Add a production-safe sequential Agent 1 -> Agent 2 -> Agent 3 -> Agent 1 GitHub Actions loop.
Keep the existing Rust CI and release workflows intact.
Use repository_dispatch for cross-workflow orchestration and prevent concurrent feature runs.
Require CI success and an APPROVE review before autonomous merge.
Document required secrets and how to start the loop.

features.title: Add persistent agent-loop state and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Persist active feature, PR, attempts, and last error in a small state file.
Recover safely from a failed or cancelled run without starting a second feature.

features.title: Add AWH CLI smoke-test gate to autonomous delivery
acceptance_criteria: Exercise core CLI commands in CI before autonomous merge.
Include MCP stdio initialization and representative tool calls.
Keep the test suite deterministic and free of network dependencies unless explicitly required.
